artworks.title: Emancipation Proclamation
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: A woman driving a horse-drawn chariot, an eagle, Abraham Lincoln and soldiers on horseback, and a gathering of countless people gather in front of a columned, domed, white marble building in this horizontal painting. The woman, riders, and soldiers, who wear blue uniforms, to the right have pale skin. About half the people in the crowd to the left have grayish-brown-colored skin, and soldiers wearing gray to the left have pale skin. At the center of the composition, the woman wears a flowing white gown and gold headpiece as she drives a red and gold chariot pulled by two white horses. The chariot bears the word “EMANCIPATION” in red letters across its front. She holds the reins with one extended hand and holds a long, gold trumpet up high with her other hand. A brown eagle flies just overhead. To our right, Abraham Lincoln wears a black suit and sits astride a chestnut-brown horse. Lincoln holds out a scroll with one word legible: “PROCLAMATION.” A man on horseback next to Lincoln has a black handlebar mustache and wears a navy-blue uniform with brass buttons. He holds a United States flag, with the words “LIBERTY TO ALL” tucked among the stars in the blue field. To the right of Lincoln, soldiers in blue uniforms on horseback line up in formation. The frontmost horses trample a torn flag with one white and two red stripes, and a blue field with ten stars. A whip, neck shackles, and a weighted chain lie on the ground nearby. In the crowd representing enslaved people, some hold up their chained hands, kneel, or pray. The soldiers wearing gray also line up, rifle barrels creating a vertical forest of bayonets. Pink-tinged dust rises between the crowd and the US Capitol, which is outlined against a patch of clear, pale-blue sky. Clouds thicken to the left and are streaked with purple, and, to the right, streaks suggest incoming rain. The artist signed the painting as if he had written his name, “A.A. Lamb,” on a rock near the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Eliza Wells
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body, facing forward with her head slightly turned to the left. She has soft facial features, light skin, and dark brown ringlet hair styled around her face. She wears a dress with a white lace collar, a pastel blue shawl with white floral patterns, a pink bow around her neck, and a small brooch. She holds a book in her left hand. The background includes a dark curtain on her right and a scenic view on her left with a river, buildings, a boat, and a colorful sky. The portrait is framed with floral and bird motifs.

artworks.title: New England Village
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a village nestled in hills and trees with a cloudy blue sky at the top. Closest to us are simple white buildings, some with white spires and others with red and brown roofs, surrounded by tall trees. In the distance there are hills, smaller trees, and sailboats on a body of water on the right. The artwork has visible brushstrokes, and the buildings are simple and flat. The color palette is earthy, with soft greens, warm tans, and light whites and yellows.

artworks.title: Liberty
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman standing upright, holding a cup with a bald eagle drinking from it. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, red lips, long curly brown hair, and is wearing a classical style gown. The gown has a blue bodice that cuts diagonally across her torso, under which is a flowing white skirt gathered at the side to reveal her leg and the lace-up sandals she wears. She holds a thin pole with an American flag hanging from it. In her other hand, she holds a white cup or bowl. A large bald eagle flies over her and dips its head down to drink from the cup. The background is brown, and it is lighter at the top of the image and darker at the bottom.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Man
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the left with a neutral expression. He has a receding hairline with dark hair, prominent eyebrows, and a pointed nose. He is wearing a dark coat with a white collar and a red garment underneath. The background is a muted brown color. One of his hands is partially visible in his lap, near a small slip of paper with writing on it.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Old Lady
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman seated, holding a closed book with her hands folded. She has light skin, small blue eyes, and a slight smile. Her hair is dark and smooth, with round spectacles on top of her head. She is wearing a dark garment with a brown shawl featuring red dots. The background is muted brown, emphasizing the woman.

artworks.title: View of Benjamin Reber's Farm
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Wellington Van Reid
artworks.medium: oil on wood on pressed wood
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in profile from the waist up. He has a prominent nose and slightly receding hairline, and his dark hair is combed back. He wears formal attire, including a dark coat, reddish-brown waistcoat, and white high-collared shirt. The background is a plain, muted reddish-brown color with an oval frame around the man, giving the image a classical portrait appearance with a simple, dark-colored border.

artworks.title: Jane L. Van Reid
artworks.medium: oil on wood on pressed wood
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile from the waist up. She has distinct facial features, dark hair with a white bonnet, and is wearing a brown dress with a white fichu. She is holding an open book in her left hand. The background is a plain, muted red oval area within a darker rectangle.

artworks.title: Man with Vial
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This image depicts the upper half of a man's body. He is seated and facing forward with his body slightly angled to the right. The man has light skin, blue eyes, and light brown, upward-styled hair. His facial features are well-defined, and he looks directly at the viewer with a faintly serious expression. He is dressed in formal attire, with a dark coat over a high-collared white shirt with horizontal pleats and a cravat-like neckwear. His left hand holds a small vial containing a red liquid, and a wedding band is visible on his right ring finger. The chair has red upholstery with a decorative scroll design on the armrest. The background is a dark brown color that lightens around the figure, drawing attention to him.

artworks.title: Wife of Man with Vial
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a red chair. She is facing the viewer, with distinct facial features, fair complexion, dark hair styled in curls, and wearing a white bonnet with a green and orange ribbon. She has a dark, patterned dress with long sleeves, a white lace collar, pearls around her neck, and a circular brooch at the center of her collar. The background is a gradient from dark to light hues.

artworks.title: Dr. Alvah Cook
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a head and shoulders portrait of a person facing forward. The person has light skin, blue eyes, and short dark brown hair. They wear a formal black coat over a high-collared white shirt with lace detailing and a white cravat. In the background, there is a red draped curtain with gold fringe and a row of books. The initials "A. C." are visible in gold letters on the dark background behind the person.

artworks.title: General Washington on a White Charger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: The Hobby Horse
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Two children with pale, peachy skin stand and sit on a rocking horse in a wallpapered interior in this square painting. Both children have short, honey-brown hair, high foreheads, dark blue eyes, and small, rounded noses. Their cheeks are smooth and the corners of their thin, pale pink lips curl slightly up. Both wear dresses with puffy, elbow-length sleeves, white collars, calf-length skirts, and wide, white pantaloons over white stockings. At the center of the composition, one child sits astride the rocking horse, which faces our right in profile. The skirt of the forest-green dress splits at the waist to fall open on either side of a white garment underneath. That child’s head turns back over one shoulder to look down and to our left. One black shoe rests in a stirrup, and the child holds a riding crop in one hand. The horse is dappled with fawn brown and white, and has a parchment-brown mane and tail. The horse’s eye we can see is black and its red mouth is open around the bridle and reins. The second child stands at the back of the rocking horse, hands resting on the crossbar that connects the toy's long, curving rockers. That child wears a crimson-red dress and holds the red ribbon of a straw bonnet in one hand. The hair is parted down the middle and that child looks at us. A black cap with a curved, shiny visor and tassels hanging from the crown rests on the base of the rocking horse. The rug has a stylized, terracotta-orange floral pattern against a pine-green background. The wall behind the children is striped with wide bands of golden yellow and moss green. A door with a gold-colored doorknob is swung inward to our left, behind the child in red, to reveal the profile of a staircase beyond. To our right, just behind the horse’s head, a wooden table is draped with a cloth patterned with vines and leaves in dark green against a pea-green background. A lamp with a tall, spindly brass base is topped with a squat, round white globe. A folded newspaper behind the child in green could rest on the table, or could be held by that child. An inscription on the masthead of the paper begins, “Dai.”

artworks.title: Old Woman Plucking a Fowl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. and Mrs. Walter Timme
artworks.description: This painting shows a person seated with their head bowed down, looking down at a large chicken in their lap. The person has warm yellow skin, deep-set eyes, and thin lips in a neutral expression. They are wearing a red hood and a dark garment with a white collar. The background is dimly lit, although we can see what looks like a stone windowsill on the left with light coming in. The chicken has brown feathers with some white feathers on its wings, and a red comb and wattle.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Skulls
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: Twelve men and perhaps a child, who is bald and wears a brown robe, kneel, sit, or prostrate themselves in front of an altar piled with three skulls in this almost square painting. All the men appear to have pale, peachy skin and wear tattered robes with hoods in shades of sky or slate blue, peanut brown, terracotta orange, or silvery gray. The man closest to the altar holds up a long cross so it almost touches the skulls. He kneels and bows deeply so his hood completely hides his face. Three more men are near him in this grouping, and another rests on the broken base of a column as he reaches forward, head bowed. The child and two taller adults stand in the background along the left edge of the composition, and four more men are clustered in the lower right corner. The two to the left in this final group have chains wrapped around their torsos and are barefoot. The leftmost reclines on one hip and looks at the open book he holds. The other two men kneel. Carnation-pink and sapphire-blue robes lie across the two steps where these four people gather. Another book and glimmering objects, perhaps pieces of armor and maybe another skull, are heaped in a pile to the left. Beyond all the people, a mint-green curtain just taller than the standing men hangs across the lower portion of a row of columns in front of pearl-white walls with molding, columns, and an arched doorway. Some brushstrokes are loose, especially in the clothing and background.

artworks.title: Portrait of an Almoner of Antwerp
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lewis Einstein
artworks.description: The painting depicts a man from the waist up, seated and facing slightly to the right. He has a light complexion, soft expression, and medium-length straight brown hair mostly covered by a flat beret-style hat. He wears a dark brown robe with wide sleeves over a dark garment, and a white shirt with a visible collar underneath. The man holds a walking stick in his left hand and a chain with several keys in his right hand, resting on a patterned surface in front of him. The background is a muted, dark green, with a shadow cast behind him and text inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Girl with a Basket of Fish
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Robertson Coe
artworks.description: This painting depicts a woman standing in profile, facing the right. She has light skin, dark hair styled in a low bun, rosy cheeks, and pink lips, and she is wearing a white off-the-shoulder blouse and a red skirt. She holds a large woven basket filled with gray-and-orange fish and is resting it on her hip. The background shows a beach-like landscape with a vast blue sky over tan dunes with hints of orange and pink. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible.

artworks.title: Girl with a Basket of Oranges
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William Robertson Coe
artworks.description: This painting shows a young woman standing in profile, facing the left and holding a basket of orange-yellow fruit. She has fair skin and light brown hair in a low bun, and she is wearing a dress with a blue vest, white sleeves, a tan skirt, a brown belt, a dark green apron, and black boots. The background includes tan ground, pale green foliage, blue water, and a pale blue sky. The brushstrokes in the painting are soft and visible.

artworks.title: Edith Reynolds
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edith Reynolds
artworks.description: This painting is a full-body portrait of a woman. She is standing in an upright position with her hands clasped together in front of her body. Her body is faced slightly to the left, but her face is turned to us. Her face is serious, with pale skin, dark, arched eyebrows, a cleft chin, and red lips in a neutral expression. She has short, dark, softly curled hair. She wears a dark dress with wide shoulders, a V-shaped neckline, and elbow-length sleeves, accessorized with gold bangles on her wrists. The background is a dark, almost black, monochromatic backdrop that blends in with the bottom of her skirt.

artworks.title: Shepherd Boys and Dog Sheltering from a Storm
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges

artworks.title: Fanciful View of the Castel Sant'Angelo, Rome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The painting shows a cityscape with a large cylindrical reddish-brown fortress on the right. In the center, a wide river winds through the city, with people by the riverbank and more people walking along a winding road on the left. In the background, there are tan buildings with terracotta roofs, a stone bridge, and a large white building with a blue dome. The sky is painted in soft blue and peach tones, with loose brushstrokes, and the water below is blue green. The wide road on the left is tan, and it curves around to join the stone bridge that crosses the river horizontally.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image shows a man with light complexion in a formal outfit against a plain background. He is turned slightly to his left, with well-defined facial features including prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and slightly upturned lips. His hair is voluminous, brushed back and slightly wavy. He is wearing a high-collared white shirt with a black jacket.

artworks.title: Lord Algernon Percy
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Howard Sturges
artworks.description: The image displays a man in 18th-century attire standing against a tree. He has fair skin and powdered white hair. He is elegantly dressed in a green coat, blue waistcoat, white cravat, dark breeches, blue stockings, and black shoes with gold buckles. The man is holding a three-cornered hat, standing with one arm on a tree branch, legs crossed at the ankle, with a calm expression and a slight smile. The background features a tree, serene landscape with foliage, a reflective body of water, distant hills, and a cloudy sky.
